summary:
55 representative apps tested

All 55 passed isolated server builds and browser interaction. 55 passed native Google Cloud Shell browser checks; 55 passed Codespaces HTTP or protocol checks.

Codespaces browser sign-in and interaction remain pending. A passing representative does not guarantee every repository using that framework will work.
scope: Actual public DOM observed after reload following the native evidence commit being pushed and synced to aswin. This receipt verifies publication and service health; functional acceptance, failed attempts, cache state and timing remain in the separate fixture evidence. Codespaces browser interaction, universal compatibility and a universal 20-second launch are not established.
